directory_path: rbi.org.in -> Citizen's Corner -> DLA's deployed by Regulated Entities
_why: The RBI directory is served through a JavaScript report viewer with no static export we can fetch. We do NOT ship invented entries: a fabricated 'RBI list' in a fraud-safety tool is exactly the kind of false authority this product exists to fight. Run scripts/import_rbi_dla.py once you export the directory to CSV/XLSX; until then the app says the directory is not loaded and links the user to the authoritative source.
